en: Illustrated view of a mid‑century mountain hotel named "Angelo d'Oro" with a restaurant on the ground floor. The multi‑story building has balconies decorated with red flowers, green shuttered windows, and a large vertical neon sign reading "HOTEL". Outdoor tables with red cloths sit on a terrace in front. In the background are tall, snow‑covered Alps‑like mountains and neighboring town buildings; a classic car is parked on the street and a landscaped path with flowerbeds leads up toward the hotel.
